[1/1] Add podcast episode browsing and transcript preview: expose the feed's transcribed episodes, let the user pick one, fetch only that transcript, and show an in-app preview before generating cards.

impact_assessment.why: The feed import currently picks the newest transcribed episode automatically, so users cannot choose a specific episode or inspect the imported text before spending LLM time.
impact_assessment.benefits: Makes podcast ingestion predictable and reviewable, reuses one feed parse, and downloads only the chosen transcript.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PodcastTranscriptRef gains episode_url and new public feed functions; dependency: none; concurrency: feed fetch and transcript fetch stay on worker threads while dialogs run on the UI thread; state: selected episode remains in memory only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep parsing pure, preserve existing parse/fetch behavior for callers, mock all network calls in tests, and verify the UI with a headless smoke run.

[1/1] Resolve Apple Podcasts show and episode URLs to their RSS feed, then reuse the existing Podcasting 2.0 chooser/transcript path; match an Apple episode by its page title.

impact_assessment.why: Podcast links are usually Apple Podcasts pages, not RSS feeds; the current importer only accepts RSS and direct transcript URLs.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can paste the link they already have. Feed resolution reuses iTunes lookup, and only the matched transcript is downloaded.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new Apple URL parser and resolver in transcript_sources; dependency: none (stdlib urllib/json); concurrency: resolution stays on the existing worker thread; state: resolved feed/title stay in memory only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mock both iTunes lookup and Apple page fetches in tests, keep title matching normalized and exact-first, and return a Why/Fix error when no episode matches.

[1/1] Harden Apple episode title matching against short-prefix false positives and remove unused test imports found by the post-commit review.

impact_assessment.why: Substring title matching could select Episode 10 when Apple names Episode 1, importing the wrong transcript.
impact_assessment.benefits: Exact matches stay first; fuzzy matches require a long, high-overlap title, so short episode numbers cannot collide.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: private matcher only; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a regression test for the Episode 1/Episode 10 collision and run the full suite.

checkpoints.description: [milestone 1/1] Apple title matching hardened: exact matches first, fuzzy prefixes require >=20 chars and >=80% length overlap, so Episode 1 cannot select Episode 10. [1/1] Add YouTube oEmbed title/channel metadata so imported videos are labeled by title, with a video-id fallback when metadata is unavailable.

impact_assessment.why: The imported YouTube source is currently labeled only by its 11-character id, which is hard to recognize in the review flow.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can confirm the correct video before generating cards; metadata failure never blocks caption import.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: TranscriptResult.title value changes; dependency: none; concurrency: one bounded metadata request inside the existing worker; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bound the oEmbed request, catch TranscriptError and fall back to the id, and test both paths.

[1/1] Cap the YouTube oEmbed metadata lookup at 5 seconds so a slow metadata endpoint cannot add the full 20-second network timeout to a caption import.

impact_assessment.why: The oEmbed title lookup is optional, but currently inherits the generic 20-second transcript timeout.
impact_assessment.benefits: Caption imports stay responsive when YouTube's metadata endpoint is slow or blocked; the id fallback remains.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: private helper signature only; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Thread the timeout through the existing JSON helper, use 5 seconds only for oEmbed, and assert the value in a test.
